M_FRONT_semantics.collision_relation: on the homogeneous one-resident collision states used in the attenuation grammar, S_SELF=M_FRONT+1
M_FRONT_semantics.controller_access: controllers need not read M_FRONT as a named register; they may reconstruct the needed predicates from current ingress and S_SELF
M_FRONT_semantics.definition: number of source-tag lineages currently supported at the front packet with ingress in the active relay direction family
M_FRONT_semantics.typing: exact current relational/source-support integer readout; not memory, not remaining-range budget, not tag count outside the current packet

canonical_site_relabeling: erase implementation tag/site labels and map the current recruitment packet to abstract FRONT_SITE while preserving declared channel labels, ingress classes, local counts, and action labels; q/recruitment index is not stored in rho
cartesian_multiplicity: excluded from rho except optional diagnostic; common independent-product scaling cannot create a causal relay state
relay_front_event: boundary at which an incoming causal front first cooccupies a previously nonresponding resident tag and thereby changes that resident's current local count signature or allowed action set
rho_components: multiset of CURRENT_INGRESS labels of incoming front sources at FRONT_SITE
CURRENT_INGRESS of the resident tag at FRONT_SITE
L_SELF exact current source-lineage multiplicity count when used
M_FRONT exact count of source-tag lineages at FRONT_SITE whose current ingress equals the relay direction
current allowed actions of incoming-front sources
paired evaluator delta signature (DELTA_S_SELF, DELTA_L_SELF, resident ACTION_SET_DELTA) on frozen self probe
transfer: Phi maps canonically relabeled incoming recruitment signature rho_k to every exact outgoing relay signature rho_(k+1) that successfully recruits the next homogeneous resident; relation is set-valued if controller action sets branch
